description: HP-87 is the Registration and Licensing Authority (R&LA) for the Janjehli region in Mandi district, Himachal Pradesh. Operating under the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil) at Thunag, this office handles vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and other transport-related services for the Janjehli and Thunag sub-divisions.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Thunag, District Mandi, Himachal Pradesh
